map.通过两次hCG动态变化计算倍增时间，鉴别宫内妊娠与异位妊娠(宫外孕): Compute doubling time from two hCG measurements to distinguish intrauterine from ectopic pregnancy
map.📖 查看「宫外孕(hCG动态)风险评估器 使用指南」: 📖 View "Ectopic Pregnancy (hCG Kinetics) Risk Assessor User Guide"
map.变化率 = (hCG₂ − hCG₁) / hCG₁ × 100%；倍增时间 D: Change rate = (hCG2 - hCG1) / hCG1 x 100%; doubling time DT = interval x ln2 / ln(hCG2/hCG1)
map.正常宮内孕婚 48h hCG 增幅≥ 66%（<1500）/≥ 53%（1500: Normal IUP: 48h hCG rise >=66% (<1500) / >=53% (1500-3000) / >=30% (>3000); below the lower limit warrants ectopic suspicion.
map.注：hCG越高倍增越慢。初始hCG<1500时48h应升高≥66%为宫内妊娠；升: Note: the higher the hCG, the slower the doubling. With initial hCG <1500, a 48h rise >=66% suggests intrauterine pregnancy; <53% strongly suggests ectopic or miscarriage.
map.监测至阴性,警惕破裂: Monitor to negative; watch for rupture
map.盆腔炎、输卵管手术史、既往宫外孕、IUD、辅助生殖: PID, tubal surgery history, prior ectopic, IUD, ART
map.停经后阴道流血+腹痛，破裂时剧烈腹痛+休克: Amenorrhea then bleeding + abdominal pain; rupture causes severe pain + shock
map.hCG阳性+超声未见宫内孕囊(需排除hCG<2000的\"鉴别区\"): Positive hCG + no intrauterine sac on ultrasound (exclude the "discriminatory zone" at hCG<2000)
map.hCG 1500–3500(经腹)/1500–2000(经阴道)，此范围超声应见: hCG 1500-3500 (abdominal) / 1500-2000 (transvaginal); a sac should be visible in this range
map.异位妊娠破裂是急症！出现剧烈腹痛、肩痛、晕厥、休克者立即急诊。hCG动态异常+腹: Ectopic rupture is an emergency! Severe pain, shoulder pain, syncope, shock -> go to ER at once. Abnormal hCG kinetics + pain needs high vigilance.
map.提示：hCG动态监测是早期鉴别宫内外妊娠的重要手段。最终诊断需结合阴道超声。hC: Tip: serial hCG is key to early IUP/ectopic differentiation; final diagnosis needs transvaginal ultrasound. In the discriminatory zone, do not judge by a single value—recheck the 48h trend. For clinical reference only.
map.早孕期间隔 48 小时测 hCG，判断倍增是否符合宫内妊娠。: In early pregnancy measure hCG 48h apart to judge whether doubling fits IUP.
map.hCG 上升不足或下降时排查异位妊娠/先兆流产。: Inadequate rise or fall -> investigate ectopic/threatened miscarriage.
map.hCG 达 2000 mIU/mL 后行阴道超声确认孕囊位置。: After hCG reaches 2000 mIU/mL, use transvaginal ultrasound to locate the sac.
map.首次 1000 mIU/mL、48 小时后 2000 mIU/mL：增幅 100: First 1000, 48h later 2000: 100% rise >= 53% minimum; DT = 48x0.693/ln(2) ~ 48h, fits normal IUP.
map.首次 1500、48 小时后 1900（增幅 26.7%）：低于 53% 下限，: First 1500, 48h later 1900 (26.7% rise): below 53% floor; suspect ectopic or poor embryonic development; recheck hCG and transvaginal ultrasound.
map.48 小时 hCG 要涨多少才正常？: How much should hCG rise in 48h to be normal?
map.宫内妊娠通常 48h 增幅 ≥53%（即倍增时间约 48h 内）；低于此但 >3: IUP usually rises >=53% in 48h (doubling ~within 48h); lower but >35% is borderline—recheck; falling suggests miscarriage or ectopic.
map.hCG 多高该看到孕囊？: How high should hCG be to see a sac?
map.阴道超声一般在 hCG ≥2000 mIU/mL 可见宫内孕囊；若此水平仍未见且: Transvaginal ultrasound usually sees an intrauterine sac at hCG >=2000 mIU/mL; if absent at that level with abnormal rise, ectopic risk is high.
